paragraphs.text: Iskene is a Kannah human from Kaldheim .

Iskene is a storyteller among the Kannah . Through vivid and evocative narratives, Iskene recounts tales of heroism, mystery, and the raw power of nature that have shaped the cultural memory of their people. They are very well traveled through Bretagard, having visited each of its snow-covered regions. These travels have led them on many adventures, including a perilous chase with trolls and a hunt for a great bear.<ref> Highland Forest and Rimewood Falls
